about_the_game:
DISCLAIMER: Once purchased, your Wind Spirit horse will appear at your ranch. To ride it, you must first build a Stable, where all horses are managed.

Legends say some horses are born with the wind in their mane. The Wind Spirit is one of them. Painted with vibrant American Indigenous motifs, this rare steed carries the heritage and pride of the open plains wherever it runs.

With this DLC, you’ll receive a horse unlike any other in the West—and its striking appearance will be passed on to its foals, ensuring your stables hold a legacy of unmatched beauty and spirit. Speed, style, and tradition come together in one remarkable mount.

From dusty trails to endless horizons, ride with the wind at your side and the eyes of the frontier on you!

KEY FEATURES:

- Tier 3 Rare Horse with Increased Speed (+7% constant speed bonus).

- Horse Energy: 500 | Speed: 126 | Endurance: 36.

- Strong Genes: foals inherit coat color and same tier/rarity.
